verdict.rationale: The only analytics evidence is indirect. You can prompt the Internal Agent for a report on how the Customer Agent is performing and where it falls short, and the Releases page lets you track the impact of configuration changes. Neither is a standing dashboard of the named exec-reporting metrics. Missing for 10: a documented analytics dashboard, explicit resolution-rate, CSAT, handoff-rate and cost-per-resolution metrics, exportable or exec-ready reporting, and independent corroboration.
